name: vllm_hadacore_transform
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_hadacore_transform.py. Hadamard (Hadacore) transform over the last dimension (a power of 2): x (M, N) in {fp16, bf16}, inplace=True (the only parametrized value). x is plain randn so no gen_inputs is needed. Because inplace=True mutates x, run() clones the input, calls _custom_ops.hadacore_transform, and returns the transformed tensor. Full output compared by the default comparator at the input dtype. Requires vLLM at eval time.
